extra_quotes: Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) was used to determine the dielectric response of NbN thin films before and after oxygen plasma treatment, enabling direct tracking of oxygen-induced optical modifications.
The NbN and Al 2O3 layer thicknesses were determined after oxygen plasma treatment by X-ray reflectivity (XRR) using a Malvern Panalytical MPD Pro theta–theta diffractometer.

Since the present model represents the oxygen-modified region and the underlying NbN as a single layer, these depth-dependent variations cannot be fully captured, leading to the small residual offsets observed at the highest incidence angles.
